units.source_text: 又看看她平日所写的字，在砚台底下发现了“忧患多时身可舍，却愁死后恶名留”之诗，

en.t: Looking again at the writing she had done in ordinary days, they found beneath the inkstone a poem saying, After long suffering one may cast away the body, yet I fear leaving an evil name after death,

units.source_text: 更确信她已投水，向宇治川凝眸眺望，

en.t: and they became still more certain that she had thrown herself into the water, and gazed intently toward the Uji River,

units.source_text: 听到那汹涌澎湃的水声，觉得可怕而又可悲，

en.t: and hearing the roar of those surging waters, they felt both terror and grief,

units.source_text: 便和右近商谈：“如此看来，小姐确是投水了，

en.t: so they conferred with Ukon, saying, From the look of this, the young lady has surely drowned herself,

units.source_text: 而我们还在东猜西测，使得各方关怀她的人都疑虑莫释，

en.t: and yet we have gone on making guesses this way and that, leaving all those who care for her unable to clear away their doubts,

units.source_text: 实在对他们不起。”

en.t: which is truly unfair to them.

units.source_text: 又说：“做那件秘密的事，原本不是出于小姐自己的心愿。

en.t: They also said, What was done in that secret affair did not originally come from the young lady's own wish.

units.source_text: 做母亲的即使在她死后闻知此事，

en.t: Even if her mother learns of it after her death,

units.source_text: 对方毕竟并非令人感到可耻的等闲之辈。

en.t: the other person, after all, is no low or shameful man.

units.source_text: 我们索性把事情如实告诉了她吧。

en.t: Let us simply tell her the truth of the matter.

units.source_text: 她为了不见遗骸而东猜西测，困惑万状，

en.t: Because she cannot see the body, she is guessing wildly and is utterly bewildered,

units.source_text: 知道了实情也许可以稍稍减释疑虑。

en.t: and if she knows the truth, perhaps her doubts may ease a little.

units.source_text: 况且殡葬亡人，必须有个遗骸，才是人世常态。

en.t: Besides, when one holds funeral rites for the dead, it is the way of the world that there should be a body.

units.source_text: 这没有遗骸的奇怪丧事倘延续多天，

en.t: If this strange funeral with no body continues for many days,

units.source_text: 定将被外人看破情由。

en.t: outsiders will certainly see through the reason for it.

units.source_text: 所以还不如把实情告诉了她，大家尽力隐讳，

en.t: So it would be better to tell her the truth, and then for everyone to do all they can to conceal it,

units.source_text: 也可聊以遮蔽世人耳目。”

en.t: so that we may at least somewhat hide it from the eyes and ears of the world.

units.source_text: 两人便把事情悄悄地告诉了夫人，说话的人悲痛欲绝，

en.t: The two of them then quietly told the lady what had happened, and the one who spoke was overcome with grief,

units.source_text: 几乎说不完全。

en.t: so much so that she could hardly finish speaking.

units.source_text: 夫人听了不胜伤心，想道：“如此看来，

en.t: When the lady heard this, she was unbearably sorrowful and thought, If this is so,

units.source_text: 吾儿确已亡身在这荒凉可怕的川流中了！”

en.t: my child has surely lost her life in this desolate and dreadful river current.

units.source_text: 悲痛之极，恨不得自己也投身水中。

en.t: Her grief reached such an extreme that she wished she too could throw herself into the water.
